name: 3d-model-viewer
displayName: STL Viewer, OBJ Viewer & glTF 3D Model Viewer
description: STL viewer, OBJ viewer, GLB viewer and glTF viewer for 3D models in VS Code. Also opens PLY and 3MF, with wireframe, glTF animations, a scene tree, model stats, point-to-point measuring and PNG screenshots, all offline.

modelViewer.maxFileMB.description: Files up to this size are opened. Larger files show a message and are not read.

enumDescriptions: Use the editor background of the current theme.
modelViewer.background.description: Background behind the model when a file opens. The toolbar can change it per tab.

enumDescriptions: Z up for STL and 3MF, Y up for glTF, OBJ and PLY.
modelViewer.upAxis.description: Which model axis points up when a file opens.

modelViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used 3D Model Viewer for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

modelViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links in the status line of the viewer. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with 3D Model Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Look at GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, PLY and 3MF models without leaving VS Code.

steps.title: Open a 3D model
steps.description:
Click a .glb, .gltf, .stl, .obj, .ply or .3mf file in the Explorer. Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan and scroll to zoom.
[Find a model file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.glb%22%5D)

media.altText: A robot arm GLB in 3D Model Viewer with the animation bar, model stats and the scene tree.

steps.title: Inspect the mesh
steps.description: Turn on Wireframe, Normals and Bounds, and switch between smooth and flat shading. The panel lists vertices, triangles, materials and the size.

steps.title: Measure and save a screenshot
steps.description: Press Measure and click two points on the model to get the distance. Screenshot saves the view as a PNG.

steps.title: Background, up axis and size limit
steps.description:
Pick the default background and up axis, and the largest file to open.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22modelViewer%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
